verdicts.reason: A keeps the original stacked left column (eyebrow > large '20% off' > body > Shop Sale pill) with the bottle on the peach circle at the right. Its flaws are minor: the headline's 'off' and the body copy run very close to the circle and bottle, and the bottom margin is tighter than the original's. B is broken. The '20% off' headline has shrunk to tiny text, now smaller than the body copy. The body copy has moved up to the top right, onto the circle. The Shop Sale button sits loose in the middle, almost touching the bottle, and the bottle runs off the bottom edge, so the hierarchy, reading order and grouping all fall apart.
